development_attempts.diagnosis: Inherited relief candidates used normal roads while wait commands use siege-avoidance roads; all rejects were unreachable moves for one formation. Original evidence retained.

real_engine_constructed_cases: Full party cavalry/infantry exchange conserves both headcounts and total troops, cavalry, food.
Underfilled party receives cavalry preference and legal actual recruitment.
Setting preference away from a settlement transfers no troops.
A real road march reaches a castle before its cavalry exchange.
Eight simultaneous private observations remain unmodified and their commands are legal.
limitations: The two smoke attempts reuse one development seed, not independent national-ranking samples.
Dedicated source trips did not occur naturally in the 21-day smoke; they are covered by bounded constructed tests.
Automatic settlement patrol composition and speed rules remain unchanged.
Actual long-run cavalry collection effectiveness and relative strategy strength are not established.
Windows and remote CI are not yet verified for this strategy.
The 12-seed ranking experiment is separate and must use its own frozen source and failure accounting.
Private raw observations, saves and machine paths are not included in the public strategy file set.
